item.title: Version 0.19.1
item.description:
SupaSidebar 0.19.1

Bug Fixes

  • Opening the sidebar now refreshes live tabs for every running browser, instead of showing empty or stale tabs until you click into a browser window.
  • Moving a folder out of its parent now updates the sidebar instantly, instead of leaving the folder hidden until the next refresh.
  • Visible gaps between rows inside folders are now gone.
